exercises.name: push_up
coaching_cues: Place hands slightly wider than shoulder-width
Brace your core and keep your hips level
Lower until your elbows reach about 90 degrees
Press back up to straight arms without locking out hard
safety_warnings: Stop if you feel sharp pain in the shoulder, elbow, or wrist
Do not let your hips sag toward the floor
Drop to your knees if you cannot keep your body straight

warmup: Do 10 arm circles in each direction, 10 shoulder blade squeezes, and 10 wall push-ups.
cooldown: Hold a doorway chest stretch and a triceps stretch for 30 seconds each.
overall_safety: This is a moderate-volume upper body plan. Keep every rep controlled. Stop and consult your physical therapist if pain increases during or after the session.
